# DBVON Data Solutions Website

Professional Jekyll website for DBVON Data Solutions, deployable on GitHub Pages.

## Features

- Clean, modern, professional design
- Fully responsive (desktop, tablet, mobile)
- SEO-friendly structure
- Contact form integration with Formspree
- Services showcase
- Client testimonials
- Companies worked with section

## Local Development

### Prerequisites

- Ruby (2.7 or higher)
- Bundler gem

### Setup

1. Install dependencies:
bundle install
